title: Methodological reflections for AI alignment research using human feedback

bias_targets.methodology: Proposing the assessment of human evaluator (AI trainer) demographics to determine if a predominantly young pool of annotators leads to the underrepresentation of information relevant to elderly populations in model summaries.

Proposing the assessment of human evaluator demographics to determine if a predominantly binary-gendered annotator pool results in the underrepresentation of information relevant to nonbinary individuals.
Evaluating human annotation flaws such as heading bias, primacy effects, and recency effects, and proposing targeted annotator instructions and proportional representation checks to mitigate them.
